sql: SELECT sku, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) AS target, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) AS baseline FROM kola.erp_sales WHERE month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08') AND city = 'Lagos' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END)
